svg.title: FindAgvUnderTrayAssignment, AGV by AGV
svg.desc: Animated: two AGVs are sent under trays before a CLEAN_GARAGE job. Each AGV gets one search that explores everything at 1 s per edge; the tray poses it reaches become its candidate list, nearest first. The first AGV takes its nearest candidate, and the next AGV searches again in the changed garage.
svg.metadata: ["Input: the garage state. AGV-1 stands on W26 and AGV-2 on W22; trays T15, T17 and T23 are parked. The goal: every enabled AGV under a tray, as an optional map from AGV id to pose.", "AGV-1: BuildStaticObstacleFilter(AGV, ..., ignore_agvs = {AGV-1}). For an AGV, parked trays count only with their legs, so an AGV can drive under them; AGV-2 at W22 is an obstacle.", "SingleSourceSearch with AgvSearchEnvironment: every edge costs 1 s and OnExpansion never stops the search, so it closes every reachable pose. Each closed pose under a tray (same or reciprocal heading) is appended to the candidate list, so the list is in order of edge count.", "AGV-1 takes its first candidate, P23. The move is applied to a copy of the garage state (OnEvent(AgvPoseChanged)), and FindRemainingAgvUnderTrayAssignment recurses for the other AGVs.", "AGV-2 searches again in the changed copy: AGV-1 now stands at P23, so that pose is blocked. The nearest remaining candidate is P15.", "Every AGV has a pose: the recursion returns the map {AGV-1: P23, AGV-2: P15}; with no assignment it returns std::nullopt. Had AGV-2 found no candidate, the loop would have tried AGV-1's next candidate, then the AGVs in another order: the first full assignment found is returned, not the one with the fewest moves."]
